observation_notes: A local production build (Next.js 16.3.6; pnpm build, next start on 127.0.0.1:3010) was driven through Playwright on 2026-09-28; release audit hash-validates this record but does not replay the session.

All six registered routes were loaded at 375, 768, 1024, and 1440 CSS pixels after network idle: 24 of 24 returned 200 with no document-level horizontal overflow, no broken images, no console errors, and no 4xx/5xx responses.

Changes since r11: LICENSE, SPEC.md, ARCHITECTURE.md and SECURITY.md were removed from the repository and from every check that required them; commentary docstrings and comments were trimmed; the README links to the removed files were dropped.

The first Tab lands on 'Skip to content' (#main-content); nav links show a 2px focus-visible ring; 'Crash and resume' is disabled because r13 is a candidate and not yet the current lineage; the missing-run page shows 'That run is not in the local ledger.' (served with HTTP 200, a known soft 404); the journal table scrolls inside its own container at 375 px without page overflow.

The built stylesheet contains a prefers-reduced-motion rule. Evidence, Runner and SigNoz are separate status cards; lineage state is shown in the Runner card detail and reported separately by /api/runtime.
Origin checks against POST /api/runs: cross-site 403, https origin 403, missing origin 403, same origin 503 runtime_unavailable because r13 is not yet activated.
